：终焉消散之后，法阵核心陷入了一阵极深沉的寂静。不是沉默——是所有人都在等待最后那一件事的发生。他们都知道它会来。
剑体透明如冰的长剑仍然悬浮在封印内核正上方，剑身上所有的银色符文全部亮着——在对话窗口中他用剑体护盾撑住了封印内核，护盾能量耗尽了。他不能说话，不能移动，但在护盾解除的那一刻，他的声音从剑身上传出来，温和依旧。
“我的意识快完全融入护盾了。碎之前把副剑的淬火数据全传给了老陆的柴斧。以后他劈柴的时候，斧刃上的银色纹路就是我的签名。诸位——用了几万年的兵器，该让它们自己走自己的路了。”
剑身上的银色符文开始逐笔暗淡。不是碎裂——是化作极细的银色光点，缓缓飘落在法阵核心每一个人的兵器上。老陆的柴斧鞘内壁多了一圈新的银色纹路；洛苍山长剑剑鞘上的裂纹自动愈合；王屠户的破军刀不再外泄杀意；秦川右手腕上的剑坠多了一道极细的银色包边。剑体完全消散前，最后一次自转——然后化为一颗银色光点，飘向秦川背后的副剑剑坠，轻轻嵌入剑坠与红绳之间，安静地亮着。

他早在欧阳矩启动诱饵计划时就已经将地脉熔岩河的全部剩余能源一次性注入了封印内核。能撑到现在，全靠熔岩河深处最后一条岩浆支脉的余温。他不能说话，但他抬起那双焦黑的拳头，在石台上最后一次按了一下。石台表面那个被烧熔的暗红色拳印，在他抬起手时已经融入了石台本身——那不是损坏，是烙印。他转身沿着法阵空洞的出口往外走。每走一步，脚下的石板就多一道焦痕。走到空洞入口时停下了，回头对着秦川无声地说了几个字。秦川读出了他的唇语——“熔岩河以后还会有。善待它。”
他走了。那双燃烧了万年的暗红色眼眸，在走出法阵核心的那一刻缓缓熄灭。
虚空夹层里，碎片的三成意识已经完全稳定在编目模式，不再需要虚空缝合压制。他在裂缝中封了无数岁月，身体早已和虚空融为一体。此刻裂缝不再需要封堵——他的存在意义也完成了。他的意识脉冲最后一次从水镜中传来，不再是断断续续的传输，而是完整的、平稳的话语。
“欧阳。你说酒窖拆了。其实没拆。老子把它藏在虚空夹层第一分馆最里面。钥匙——在老地方。”他顿了顿，“把秦川的凡人医药手册放一本在分馆。以后来看书的人——也要懂得治人。”
水镜中他的意识脉冲在几息后完全消散了。虚空夹层在他留下的虚空缝合阵中自动开始自行维护。
赵伯始终没有醒来。他坐在蒲团上，铜灯仍在面前安静地燃烧。灯焰比之前更亮了，里面不仅有因果烙印的金色光芒，还有无数从碎片体内抽离出的历代死者因果残片。那些残片在灯焰中缓缓旋转，像一条极细的银河。秦川跪在蒲团前，将他的手背烙印与铜灯最后校准了一次。老人没有睁眼，但他枯瘦的手指在秦川手背上轻轻拍了一下。秦川将赵伯的铜灯从石台上端起来，放在老陆手边。
老陆靠在蒲团上，已经醒了。他正用磨刀石一下一下地磨着那把柴斧。磨刀声很慢——笃。笃。笃。和青山村每一个早晨一样。秦川将王屠户的破军刀从石柱旁拿起来，放在老陆旁边。老陆看了一眼，继续磨斧头。

Chapter 247 The Disappearance of the Supremes (Page 1)
: After it finally dissipated, the core of the array fell into a deep silence. It's not silence - everyone is waiting for the last thing to happen. They all knew it was coming.
The long sword with a body as transparent as ice is still suspended directly above the seal core, and all the silver runes on the sword are all lit up - in the dialogue window, he used the sword shield to support the seal core, and the shield energy was exhausted. He couldn't speak or move, but at the moment when the shield was lifted, his voice came out from the sword, still gentle.
"My consciousness is almost completely integrated into the shield. I sent all the quenching data of the secondary sword to Lao Lu's firewood axe. When he chops firewood from now on, the silver lines on the ax blade will be my signature. Everyone - weapons that have been used for tens of thousands of years, it's time to let them go their own way."
The silver runes on the sword began to dim gradually. It didn't shatter - it turned into extremely fine silver light spots, slowly falling on the weapons of everyone in the core of the circle. There is a new silver pattern on the inner wall of Lao Lu's ax scabbard; the cracks on the scabbard of Luocangshan's long sword heal automatically; Butcher Wang's broken saber no longer leaks murderous intent; the sword pendant on Qin Chuan's right wrist has a very thin silver edge. Before the sword body completely dissipated, it rotated for the last time - and then turned into a silver point of light, floating towards the secondary sword pendant behind Qin Chuan, gently embedded between the pendant and the red rope, and lit up quietly.
He had already injected all the remaining energy from the leyline lava river into the seal core at one time when Ouyang Ju launched the bait plan. The ability to hold on until now depends entirely on the remaining warmth of the last magma branch deep in the lava river. He couldn't speak, but he raised his blackened fists and pressed them one last time on the stone platform. The melted dark red fist mark on the surface of the stone platform had been integrated into the stone platform itself when he raised his hand - that was not damage, but a brand. He turned around and walked out along the empty exit of the magic circle. With every step he took, there was another scorch mark on the stone slab under his feet. He stopped when he reached the entrance of the cave, turned back and said a few words silently to Qin Chuan. Qin Chuan read his lips - "There will be rivers of lava in the future. Treat it well."
He's gone. The pair of dark red eyes that had burned for thousands of years slowly extinguished the moment they walked out of the core of the magic circle.
In the void mezzanine, 30% of the fragment's consciousness has been completely stabilized in the cataloging mode, and no longer needs to be suppressed by void suture. He has been sealed in the crack for countless years, and his body has long been integrated with the void. Now the crack no longer needs to be sealed - the purpose of his existence is complete. The pulse of his consciousness came from the water mirror for the last time. It was no longer an intermittent transmission, but a complete and smooth speech.
"Ouyang. You said the wine cellar was dismantled. In fact, it was not dismantled. I hid it in the innermost part of the first branch on the void mezzanine. The key is in the same place." He paused, "Put a copy of Qin Chuan's Medical Manual for Mortals in the branch. People who read the book in the future must also know how to treat people."
The pulse of his consciousness in the water mirror completely dissipated after a few breaths. The void interlayer automatically began to maintain itself in the void suture formation he left behind.
Uncle Zhao never woke up. He sat on the futon, the copper lamp still burning quietly in front of him. The flame of the lamp was brighter than before. It contained not only the golden light of the Karma brand, but also countless Karma fragments of the dead from past generations that had been extracted from the fragments. Those fragments rotated slowly in the lamp flame, like a very thin Milky Way. Qin Chuan knelt in front of the futon and calibrated the mark on the back of his hand with the copper lamp for the last time. The old man didn't open his eyes, but his skinny fingers gently patted the back of Qin Chuan's hand. Qin Chuan lifted Uncle Zhao's bronze lamp from the stone platform and placed it next to Lao Lu.
Lao Lu leaned on the futon and was already awake. He was sharpening the wood ax with a whetstone. The sound of sharpening the knife is very slow - Du. Benedict. Benedict. Just like every morning in Qingshan Village. Qin Chuan picked up Butcher Wang's broken saber from the stone pillar and placed it next to Lao Lu. Lao Lu took a look and continued to sharpen his axe.
